page.notes: The large initial A is joined to "Carnania" as "ACarnania". Several left-edge letters are cut off by the red page edge and are marked [?] (Achaeorum, Ætolia, Ætolorum, phiclyonicum, Status, vorum, ratum, ntia, Romanis, 266). The line after "popu-" should continue with the rest of the word, but only "82." is visible on the scan, so the continuation is not transcribed. The mark before "Acarnanes" and the small marks at the top and right edges are not printed text and are omitted. No running head or page number is clearly printed.
